subject: MAP kickoff: HelixAI pilot — goals & timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: HelixAI pilot — goals & timeline

Hi Anna — great to connect last week.  As discussed, I pulled together a starter Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on goals, roles, and the timeline to get to a pilot decision. ￼

Quick summary of what I’m proposing:
- Objective: validate retrieval-augmented-generation workflow for HelixAI support docs (target accuracy > 85%)
- Pilot duration: 6 weeks (POC -> evaluation -> close decision)
- Success criteria: latency < 250ms p95, end-to-end accuracy metric, and integration checklist completed
- Key owners: Anna (champion / product), Trevor (procurement / legal), Rishi (AE), Marissa (CS lead)

I’ve attached HelixAI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx and a one-pager outlining scope.  Can you confirm the goals above and whether the 6-week runway looks right for you?  If so I’ll book a 30-min kickoff next week to walk the team through roles and required artifacts (security checklist, test prompts, infra access).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm goals and timeline (reply)
2) We lock an internal kickoff meeting and invite the engineering and security contacts
3) Redwood sends the eval prompt set and passes for initial run

Thanks — appreciate the leadership on this.  I’ll keep the timeline flexible but would like to get the kickoff scheduled early next week if possible.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

Attachments: HelixAI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot_scope_one-pager.pdf (pdf)

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@helixai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Trevor Miles <trevor.miles@helixai.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: HelixAI pilot — goals & timeline

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of notes from our side:
- Pilot timeline: 6 weeks is fine but we’d like an explicit week 0 readiness check to validate data access and tagging (so effectively 7 calendar weeks with week 0 being setup)
- Success criteria: can we add SLA measurement (uptime target for the test endpoint and token cost band) to the spreadsheet? Procurement will want cost predictability.
- Roles: Trevor (cc’d) is our procurement lead and will handle the legal/contract side — he can flag terms we need up front.

Proposed kickoff times: Mon Apr 5 at 10am PT or Tue Apr 6 at 11am PT — I prefer Mon if that works for you all.

I’m attaching a brief internal note for the team on the expected data slices and primary use-cases.  We’ll also include the engineering lead on the kickoff invite (Carlos Ruiz).

Anna
VP Product, HelixAI
anna.lopez@helixai.com | +1 650-555-0987

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: HelixAI pilot — goals & timeline

Hi Anna — great to be looped in.  I’ll own success criteria instrumentation and the evaluation plan on our side. A few operational items we should lock during kickoff:
- Week 0 checklist: sample dataset access (S3 bucket), service account for API keys, and a small test harness for prompt runs
- Evaluation prompts: please share primary/secondary prompt sets and any red-teaming cases you want flagged up front
- Integration owner: please add Carlos Ruiz (eng) to the invite — we’ll need him for infra setup and to approve KV cache settings

Rishi — I’m available Mon Apr 5 at 10am PT for the kickoff. I’ll prepare a short runbook for the pilot and a template for the evaluation metrics we’ll track weekly.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks all.  Mon Apr 5 at 10am PT is confirmed. I’ll send a calendar invite with the kickoff agenda, and include Carlos Ruiz and Trevor on the invite. Agenda (high level):
- Introductions and success criteria alignment (10m)
- Week 0 readiness and infra checklist (10m)
- Evaluation plan and metric tracking (10m)
- Roles, decision gates, and contract path (5m)
- Next steps and parking lot (5m)

Action items I’ll own before the kickoff:
- Finalize the MAP spreadsheet and add SLA/cost band row (I’ll update and share a link)
- Upload eval prompt set to the shared Drive folder
- Marissa to circulate the evaluation metric template

If anything changes on your side, ping me and I’ll adjust. Looking forward to kicking this off.

—
